Regulation: B.C. Reg. 107/2026
Made under: Employment And Assistance For Persons With Disabilities Act
Published in: No. 12 – B.C. Regs. 99 to 109, June 30, 2026
Deposit date: June 26, 2026

B.C. Reg. 107/2026, deposited June 26, 2026, under theEMPLOYMENT AND ASSISTANCE FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES ACT[section 26]. Order in Council 267/2026, approved and ordered June 26, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that, effective July 13, 2026, the Employment and Assistance for Persons with Disabilities Regulation, B.C. Reg. 265/2002, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — S. MALCOLMSON,Minister of Social Development and Poverty Reduction; J. OSBORNE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 2.1 of the Employment and Assistance for Persons with Disabilities Regulation, B.C. Reg. 265/2002, is amended by adding the following paragraph: (f)	a person who has a Persons with Disabilities designation under the Income Assistance Program of the Department of Indigenous Services (Canada), and the designation was made by the Department of Indigenous Services (Canada), or by an agent of the Department of Indigenous Services (Canada), because the person has a severe mental or physical impairment as described in section 2 (2) (a) and (b) of the Act. minutes_briefs.title: BC disability assistance now recognizes federal Indigenous Services designation
minutes_briefs.summary: As of July 13, 2026, British Columbia has changed its rules for who qualifies for disability assistance. People who have a Persons with Disabilities designation from the federal Department of Indigenous Services (Canada) — given because they have a severe mental or physical impairment — will now automatically qualify under BC's Employment and Assistance for Persons with Disabilities program. This means they no longer need to go through a separate BC application process.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you or someone you support has a federal Indigenous Services disability designation, contact the BC ministry to confirm eligibility and start receiving benefits.

key_dates.label: BC recognizes federal Indigenous Services disability designation takes effect
